summary: Frontend-only retest of the live-editor move/resize persistence fix (public site now applies --ed-t/--ed-w/--ed-h at >=961px). IMPORTANT: when testing started, the dev server was serving a STALE bundle: hot reload had not picked up the LiveEditor.jsx edit (bundle still had innerWidth < 1440 and the '1440px and wider' note), although the index.css change had compiled. Touching the file didn't help, so I ran `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend`. After the restart all checks passed: 7/7 desktop persistence runs and 4/4 tablet/phone overflow checks. The narrow-screen note boundary is correct. Content was restored afterwards and the diff is clean.

issues: Minor/observation: on /about at 1920, dragging the full-width heading with the move grip also shrank its box from 1113px to 337px wide (it now fits the text, probably because the move sets place-self:start). Position persisted correctly. Just check this is intended.

Observation: a saved --ed-w is still applied on tablet/phone as min(--ed-w, 100%). For example, a heading resized to 162px stays 162px wide at 390 and 820. There is no overflow, but the text wraps more ('WHO WE / ARE'). This is by design, not a bug.

action_items: Hot reload on /app/frontend did not pick up the LiveEditor.jsx edit (it served the old 1440 logic until I restarted the frontend with supervisorctl). After editing, check that changes reach the served bundle, e.g. curl localhost:3000/static/js/bundle.js | grep for the new code, or restart the frontend.
Optional: confirm that a move shrinking a full-width heading's box is intended.
critical_code_review_comments: The photo-only rules under @media (max-width:1439px) (figure.photo height:auto, aspect-ratio) still use 1440, while the --ed-h rule now applies from 961px. At 961-1439, a resized photo gets --ed-h height from the 961 rule but height:auto from the 1439 rule (photo rule wins on specificity). So photo height in the public view may differ from the editor at 961-1439. Not tested; check that this is intended.
LiveEditor.jsx is 704 lines (just over 700); consider splitting it.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Use the browser tool with page.context.browser.new_context(viewport=...) for each width. Log in at /admin/login (login-email, login-password, login-submit), open /?edit=1, click 'main [data-edit="tagline"]', then drag [data-testid=live-move-grip] or live-resize-e with mouse down/move/up. Press Esc, click live-save-btn, wait for live-status 'Everything is saved', then live-exit-btn. Run backup_restore_content.py backup before and restore after. If behaviour looks old, check that the served bundle is fresh.
